description: Search Scopus documents, authors, affiliations, and serial sources through the Elsevier APIs.

auth.label: Elsevier API Key
auth.description: Elsevier API key sent in the X-ELS-APIKey header. Create or manage a key at https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage and review the official API policies at https://dev.elsevier.com/policy.html

extraFields.label: Institutional Token
extraFields.description: Optional Elsevier Institutional Token sent in X-ELS-Insttoken to establish subscription entitlements when institutional IP authentication is unavailable. Request access through Elsevier API Support: https://dev.elsevier.com/support.html
